sentences.text:
(G.R. Case No.512 Of 2022) vs In Re: Anil Baran Singh @ Anil
Singh & Ors on 16 October, 2023

In Re: An application for bail under Section 439 of the Code of Crimina  Procedure filed on 10.10.2023 in connection with Ranibandh Police  Station Case No.55 of 2022 dated 09.09.2022 under Sections  498A/304B of the Indian Penal Code and subsequently charge sheet  submitted under Sections 498A/304B/34 of the Indian Penal Code.
 (G.R. Case No.512 of 2022)
 And  In Re: Anil Baran Singh @ Anil Singh & Ors.
 ... ... Petitioners  Mr. Arkaprabho Roy  Mr. Rhiddhiman Mukherjee  ... ... for the petitioners  Mr. Tanmay Kr. Ghosh  Mr. A. Sen  ... ... for the State  1.
Petitioner no.1 is the brother-in-law and petitioner no.2 is the septuagenarian mother-in-law of the victim-housewife.
2. It is submitted on behalf of the petitioners that they are in custody for more than 400 days.
It is further submitted there is slow progress in trial and only two witnesses have been examined.
Learned Advocate for the State seeks time to produce the case diary.
4. We have considered the materials on record.
Allegations against the petitioners are vague.
Trial is progressing at a slow pace.
Under such circumstances and in view of the period of detention suffered by the petitioners, we are of the opinion they may be released on interim bail.

5. Accordingly, the petitioners namely, (1) Anil Baran Singh @ Anil Singh & (2) Lakshi Singh @
Lakshi Rani Singh, be released on interim bail upon furnishing a bond of Rs.10,000/- (Rupees Ten (G.R. Case No.512 Of 2022) vs In Re: Anil Baran Singh @ Anil Singh & Ors on 16 October, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/2166950/
1 thousand only) each, with two sureties of like amount each, one of whom must be local, to the satisfaction of the learned Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Khatra, Bankura subject to condition that the said petitioners shall appear before the trial court on every date of hearing until further orders and shall not intimidate witnesses or tamper with evidence in any manner whatsoever.
6. The interim bail shall continue till 30.11.2023 or until further orders, whichever is earlier.

7. Let the matter appear under the same heading on 20.11.2023.
8.
Case diary be positively produced on the adjourned day.

(Gaurang Kanth, J.) (Joymalya Bagchi, J.)
(G.R. Case No.512 Of 2022) vs In Re: Anil Baran Singh @ Anil Singh & Ors on 16 October, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/2166950/
